title: npm and standalone distribution artifacts
objective: Build and publish the CLI through npm and verified standalone OS/architecture artifacts with independent CLI/Skill versions and compatibility metadata.
input: N01 workspace and release build baseline
acceptance_criteria: CLI and Skill can be released independently; compatibility is checked.
macOS/Linux/Windows core CLI targets pass required CI.
Only standalone targets verified in release CI are advertised.
npm and GitHub Release workflows publish documented artifacts.
undo_classification: Publishing is external; do not publish automatically and do not reuse/delete release assets without approval.
approval_requirements: Explicit user approval before publishing packages or releases.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; repeated integrity failure escalates without destructive retry.
